findings.current: محفوظ اثاثوں کے نام اور ٹیگ بنانا
findings.problem: Both verbs are the wrong collocation. Naming an asset is نام رکھنا - the catalogue's own form is in ui.chat.tags.auto_tag_help ('فورک کا نام رکھتے وقت') - while نام بنانا carries the 'make a name for oneself' idiom. Tagging an asset is ٹیگ لگانا; ٹیگ بنانا means creating a tag object, which is exactly what ui.chat.tags.empty means by 'ٹیگ بنائیں'. The same construction sits in the sibling descriptions value, so the defect is family-wide rather than new here.
findings.fix: محفوظ اثاثوں کے نام رکھنا اور ٹیگ لگانا — clause 28->34 chars, whole value 128->134 (ratio 1.11 vs en 121); still inside the card's ellipsis.
findings.evidence: global: 'نام رکھ' 1 hit (ui.chat.tags.auto_tag_help), 'ٹیگ لگ' 0, 'ٹیگ بنا' 3 (all create-a-tag).

findings.problem: House-term inconsistency. The corpus renders 'comment' as تبصرہ/تبصرے in all 21 occurrences (ui.code_review, ui.hub.comments, ui.chat.commentary_actions) and never as کمنٹ (0 across 6801 shipped ur values) - including the code-review surface this card is read beside. کمنٹس is idiomatic Pakistani dev Urdu, so this is a consistency call, not a comprehension one; no glossary file exists in this repo, so the evidence is corpus usage, not a formal glossary.

Cross-family mismatch on one house term. This file follows its sidecar exactly ('AI-isms' ... stays untranslated), while the sibling ui.agents.descriptions value renders the same English term as AI کے مخصوص انداز. Both strings describe the same agent and a user can see the roster line and the installed card together. The routing side is the conformant one, so the fix belongs in the sibling, not here.
findings.fix: No change to this file. Align ui.agents.descriptions.copy_reviewer to AI-isms, or record the divergence deliberately in that namespace's ledger note.
findings.evidence: routing keeps Latin per src/i18n/catalogues/en/ui.agents.routing.context.json; descriptions value read from scratchpad/agents-i18n/ur/ui.agents.descriptions.json.

findings.current: ٹرمینل یوزر انٹرفیسز کی ڈیزائننگ یا ان کا جائزہ
findings.problem: Two slips in the opening clause. یوزر occurs 0 times in the shipped Urdu corpus while the app says صارف 11 times, including صارف انٹرفیس in ui.settings.updates - and EN spells 'user' out here, so it is not a keep-English token. And کی ڈیزائننگ is the gerund-of construction; the family's own parallel form is ڈیزائن کرنا ('ٹرمینل انٹرفیسز ڈیزائن کرنا اور ان کا جائزہ لینا') and the corpus has 0 'ڈیزائننگ' against 1 'ڈیزائن کر'.
findings.fix: ٹرمینل صارف انٹرفیسز ڈیزائن کرنا یا ان کا جائزہ (229 chars, ratio 0.881 unchanged).

findings.current: لے آؤٹ، اسپیسنگ، رنگ یا عبارت کا اچھی طرح پڑھا جانا
findings.problem: 'reads well' is carried in as the passive پڑھا جانا ('to be read') and distributed over layout, spacing and colour, which are not read in Urdu - a layout کا پڑھا جانا is a calque, the text idiom belongs to عبارت alone. The 'whether' question is also nominalised into a list item, so it reads as a third activity beside the review instead of the question the review asks (the hi audit raised the same nominalisation as R7).
findings.fix: لے آؤٹ، اسپیسنگ، رنگ یا عبارت پڑھنے میں اچھے لگیں (211 chars, ratio 1.045).

findings.current: — اس سے الگ کہ وہ دکھتی کیسی ہے، یعنی بصری/ڈیزائن جائزہ۔
findings.problem: The exclusion points at the wrong thing. EN excludes 'a visual/design review of how it looks'; the Urdu makes 'how it looks' (وہ دکھتی کیسی ہے) the referent of الگ and then apposes یعنی بصری/ڈیزائن جائزہ to it, so the appearance question and the design review are equated. وہ دکھتی کیسی ہے also inverts natural Urdu order (کیسی دکھتی ہے). The contrast survives, which is why this is polish rather than a claim error.
findings.fix: — یہ اس بصری/ڈیزائن جائزے سے الگ ہے، جو یہ دیکھتا ہے کہ وہ کیسی دکھتی ہے۔ (280 chars, ratio 1.089; offset by the rest of the value staying short).

findings.current: یہ طے کرنا کہ کوئی چیز کیسے بنے گی
findings.problem: The sidecar asks for HOW's capitalisation to be carried by whatever device the locale uses. Urdu has one and this family already uses it - ux_reviewer marks EXPERIENCE with ہی (صارف کے تجربے ہی کو). Here کیسے sits unmarked in an otherwise neutral clause.
findings.fix: …یہ طے کرنا کہ کوئی چیز بالکل کیسے بنے گی: (168 chars, ratio 0.994).

findings.problem: 'keyboard-first' asserts priority (the keyboard is the primary input, the mouse optional); کی بورڈ پر مبنی says only that the flow is keyboard-based. The wording is byte-identical to the sibling descriptions key, so it is a family-wide choice and one fix should cover both.
findings.fix: کی بورڈ کو ترجیح دینے والا فلو (240 chars, ratio 0.923).

findings.current: PR، MR، diff، commit رینج یا پیچ میں
findings.problem: One compound term is split across scripts: commit stays Latin while its head noun is transliterated رینج, inside an enumerated list whose other entries are wholly Latin (PR, MR, diff). Bidi order is correct, so this is typographic consistency, not a rendering break.
findings.fix: commit range (147 chars, ratio 0.936) - or کمیٹ رینج if the transliteration is preferred; pick one treatment for the whole term.

findings.current: فنکشن یا کلاس کہاں متعین ہے
findings.problem: متعین carries 'determined / set / resolved' in this corpus (ui.chat.session_status.no_model_resolved: 'ابھی کوئی ماڈل متعین نہیں ہوا'), so 'کہاں متعین ہے' reads 'where it is set'. For a definition in source the code sense is ڈیفائن / بیان کیا گیا. Recoverable from context, hence a NIT.
findings.fix: …فنکشن یا کلاس کہاں ڈیفائن ہے یہ ڈھونڈنا (257 chars, ratio 0.996).

findings.current: ایجنٹس کے درمیان متوازی کام شروع کرنا
findings.problem: 'across agents' becomes 'among the agents'. کے درمیان is the ordinary Urdu 'among' and the parallel-work sense survives, but it locates the work in the space between agents rather than making them the workers it is spread over (the hi audit graded the same construct R1, the fr M1). A crisper form names the agents as the field.
findings.fix: ایجنٹس میں متوازی کام شروع کرنا (119 chars, ratio 0.875).
